Is AfroKauf free for customers?
Yes. Searching, calling and messaging shops is free. You pay the shop for what you buy, as always.
How does ordering work?
Put products from one shop in your order and send it, on WhatsApp or with the order form. The shop confirms, and you pick up and pay in the shop.
Who runs the shops?
Every shop is independent. AfroKauf checks each shop before its page goes live and shows it in one place.
I own a shop. How do I get listed?
Fill in the form on List your shop. The basic listing is free and usually live within 2 working days.
Something on a shop page is wrong. What can I do?
Tap "Report wrong information" on the shop page, or write to us. We fix it quickly.
